title: Run Off The Bike · 15 mins
notes:
Intensity: Steady

Get off your bike and run steady in Z2. Running off the bike at a higher intensity helps your body get used to transitioning from cycling to race-pace running. By dropping back to Z2 after a short time, you will not risk excess fatigue or injury.
